subject: Pricing follow-up: per-token slabs, model premium mapping, and commitment mechanics
messages:
From: Jane Peterson <jane.peterson@finlytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify hosted pricing for 50M tokens + premium models

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers look promising. Before we lock in an internal budget, can you confirm a few pricing mechanics for Redwood's hosted API? We're planning for an initial committed volume of ~50M input+output tokens/month (12-month term target) and want to understand how that maps to the per-token slabs and any model-specific premiums. Specific questions: 

- Do commits apply to combined tokens (prompt+completion), or only generated tokens?
- How do embeddings get billed relative to chat/generation (per-token vs per-embed unit)?
- How do you apply model premiums (e.g., "premium-xl" vs standard base) — is it a flat multiplier, a separate SKU, or per-route pricing?
- Any streaming surcharges or higher rates for synchronous low-latency SLA?

We're also evaluating a cheaper fallback model for non-critical requests, so any details on automatic routing/fallback (and whether that affects billing) is useful.

Can you share an indicative price table (per-token at our expected volume) and the legal/PO steps if we decide to commit? Send to me and our procurement alias (procure@finlytics.com).

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Peterson
Head of AI Platforms, FinLytics
---
FinLytics | www.finlytics.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jane Peterson <jane.peterson@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify hosted pricing for 50M tokens + premium models

Hi Jane — great to hear and thanks for the clear list. I pulled together a short summary and attached our baseline pricing sheet for the hosted API (see 2027-06-15_REDWOOD_PRICING_SHEET.xlsx). Highlights below; happy to hop on a quick call to walk through numbers.

Quick answers up front:
- Commits cover billable tokens (prompt + completion). We roll them together for usage credits and commitments.
- Embeddings are billed per-embedding-unit; we show an equivalent per-1k-token rate on the sheet to make apples-to-apples comparisons. For most workloads embeddings run at ~0.25x the base chat token rate when normalized.
- Premium models are charged as a multiplier on top of the base per-token rate (not a separate SKU). Typical mapping: premium-small = 1.6x, premium-xl = 2.5x. Exact mapping depends on the model family — I listed the most common ones on the sheet.
- Low-latency/streaming is a small surcharge for guaranteed sub-50ms tail (applies only if you opt into the SLA).

Indicative rates for a 12-month, 50M token/month commit (monthly average) — all USD, per 1k tokens equivalent: 
- Base model (standard): $0.90 per 1k tokens
- Premium-small: $1.44 per 1k tokens (1.6x)
- Premium-xl: $2.25 per 1k tokens (2.5x)
- Embeddings (normalized): $0.23 per 1k-token equivalent

If you want to use a cheaper fallback route, requests routed to the fallback model are billed at that model's rate. Commits are aggregated across routes, so routing doesn't cause double-counting, but it will affect your blended effective rate.

Next steps if you like this band: I can propose a 12-month commitment with a 10–12% volume discount on the base per-token rates (slabed by actual total commit: 50–100M band gets 10%, 100M+ bands higher). Marissa and Rishi — can you confirm if we can stretch to 12% for a 12-mo 50M commit?

Cheers,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Email: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachments: 2027-06-15_REDWOOD_PRICING_SHEET.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify hosted pricing for 50M tokens + premium models

Sofia / Rishi — quick internal note from pricing:

- Approve 12% discount for a 12-month, 50M/month commit provided FinLytics signs the standard term sheet and agrees to a 60-day payment SLA. We want to avoid deeper discounts without a higher commit or longer term.
- Recommend we explicitly call out model-mapping in the term sheet (table: model name -> premium multiplier) to avoid post-signature disputes.
- Embeddings: keep the normalized guidance on external docs but add a clause that large-scale embedding pipelines may move to a per-1k-embed-unit pricing if vectors exceed 1M/day (to protect against abuse).
- Streaming SLA: charge an additional $0.05 per 1k tokens for guaranteed sub-50ms tail; this is optional and can be toggled route-level.

Sofia — if you propose 12% to the customer, include the two attachments: baseline pricing sheet and a short term sheet with model mapping. I'll review the term sheet draft before it goes out.

Marissa
VP, Commercial

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jane Peterson <jane.peterson@finlytics.com>, FinLytics Procurement <procure@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify hosted pricing for 50M tokens + premium models

Hi Jane — thanks, and good news: we can hold 12% off the base per-token rates for a 12-month, 50M/month commit under the conditions Marissa noted (60-day payment terms, standard term sheet). I attached a short term sheet with explicit model->multiplier mapping for clarity (2027-06-17_FinLytics_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf). Key points summarized: 

- Commit: 50M tokens/month (prompt+completion) for 12 months
- Discount: 12% off base per-token rates
- Premium multipliers: premium-small = 1.6x, premium-xl = 2.5x (table in term sheet)
- Embeddings: normalized at ~0.25x base; large-scale embed clause for >1M/day
- Optional streaming SLA: +$0.05 per 1k tokens for <50ms tail latency
- Billing: monthly invoices, net-60 by default for this deal

If that looks good I can route the term sheet to your legal/procurement via DocuSign and we can aim for an early-July start date. Will you confirm the contact for the PO?

Best,
Sofia

Attachments: 2027-06-17_FinLytics_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf (PDF, 4 pages)

From: Jane Peterson <jane.peterson@finlytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: FinLytics Procurement <procure@finlytics.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify hosted pricing for 50M tokens + premium models

Sofia — this is exactly what we needed, thanks. The team is comfortable with the 12% band and the multiplier table; procurement will run the term sheet through legal and return any redlines. A couple of quick asks: 

- Can you include a short runbook/FAQ on how routing to fallback models affects logs/traceability and whether those routed requests will still count toward the commit? We need this for our security reviewers.
- Please send the DocuSign link when ready and copy procure@finlytics.com.

We expect to get the PO out by 6 Jul if legal is clean. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Jane
